content.short: Rarimo NFT Checkout enables developers to build decentralized NFT checkouts with non-native tokens.
content.description: Purchasing NFTs across marketplaces can be burdensome for users who hold tokens on different blockchains, typically requiring a multi-step process. When liquidity resides on one chain and an NFT is listed on another, buyers often must leave the marketplace, swap their tokens on an exchange (and pay swap fees), and then return to complete the purchase. Rarimo NFT Checkout enables buying any NFT with any crypto on any chain in a single transaction, removing the need to juggle cross-chain steps and simplifying cross-chain NFT purchases.
